Adani Group to invest over ₹1 lakh crore in West Bengal by 2035

The Adani Group has announced plans to invest over ₹1 lakh crore (approximately $10.4 billion) in West Bengal by 2035. The investment will span across various sectors including ports, logistics, data centers, and power. Additionally, the group intends to establish a 2,000-bed medical institution in New Town, with an associated healthcare project valued at Rs 4,000 crore. Gautam Adani made the announcement regarding the investment, which is expected to enhance infrastructure and create job opportunities in the state.
